item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q020_syntaxin_fragment_reclassification","answer":"In the current SCOPe release, 2.08, the 1br0 and 1ez3 entries should be read as partial syntaxin-1A/t-SNARE domains, not as evidence for a separate fragment fold. SCOPe classifies d1br0a_ and the three 1ez3 chains d1ez3a_, d1ez3b_, and d1ez3c_ as a.47.2.1: class a, All alpha proteins; fold a.47, STAT-like; superfamily a.47.2, t-snare proteins; family a.47.2.1, t-snare proteins; protein Syntaxin 1A N-terminal domain; species Norway rat. Each of those fragment domains is annotated as a three-helical fragment similar to one spectrin repeat and is flagged ms, meaning it is missing secondary structures from the common domain. By contrast, 1dn1 chain B is d1dn1b_, also in a.47.2.1, but under SCOPe 2.08 it is an automated match to the full replacement template d3c98b_ and has no ms fragment warning; the 2.08 SEQRES-domain lengths make the scale difference explicit, with d1br0a_ at 120 residues, d1ez3a_ at 124 residues, and d1dn1b_ at 222 residues. The biological conclusion is therefore that 1br0 and 1ez3 saw only the local Habc/three-helix part of a larger syntaxin fold. Their a.47.2.1 placement supports syntaxin/t-SNARE family and superfamily homology for that fragment, but it is unsafe to transfer a complete full-domain model from the fragment coordinates, to choose them as representatives of the complete syntaxin chain-B domain, or to infer spectrin-repeat homology or spectrin function merely because the fragment resembles one spectrin repeat. For full-domain template use or representative selection, prefer complete a.47.2.1 structures such as 1dn1B/3c98B; for broader comparisons, the shared a.47 STAT-like fold only indicates a common architecture, because SCOPe does not imply homology above the superfamily level.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47654/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47661/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47662/homology","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1br0a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1ez3a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1dn1b_?release=2.08"]}]}
